_note: RFC 7638 JWK Thumbprint vectors for Ed25519 keys (ADR-013 D4). Shared by the Go (internal/rampthumbprint), TS (src/edge/src/thumbprint.ts) and Python (src/mcp/src/ramp_mcp_shim/thumbprint.py) implementations so all three prove byte-identical output. Each entry: a base64url-no-pad raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key and its expected base64url-no-pad thumbprint = base64url(SHA-256(canonical JWK)). Canonical JWK is {"crv":"Ed25519","kty":"OKP","x":"<base64url-nopad(pubkey)>"} with members in lexicographic order, no whitespace. Values are additionally cross-checked against an independent canonical-JWK construction (json.dumps sort_keys; see src/mcp/tests/test_thumbprint.py::test_fixture_thumbprints_match_independent_construction); the last vector uses the RFC 8032 Ed25519 test-vector public key.
